name: project-pane
description: Side pane for the current repo: git state with a one-press GitHub sync, Netlify deploys, PRs and CI, Supabase project. Hungarian or English.

language.title: Language / Nyelv
language.description: "auto" (default): Hungarian when the system locale (LANG) is Hungarian, English otherwise. "hu": magyar. "en": English.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a git repository (it seats once the terminal is at least 144 columns wide). /project always opens it.
